verdict.rationale: Expensify documents its own Integration Server API, with partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret credentials and an OAuth2 authorization-code flow for acting on behalf of users. Nothing in the evidence shows which operations that API covers or whether it matches the UI. The 'Ask Expensify' natural-language features are an in-app assistant, not API access, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented API coverage of expenses, reports, approvals, workspaces, cards, travel and invoices; any statement or proof of API/UI parity; independent corroboration of API completeness.
